title: LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS AS AUTOMATED ALIGNERS FOR BENCHMARKING VISION-LANGUAGE MODELS
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus was on general capabilities such as perception, reasoning, planning, and value alignment (defined as security and privacy).
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it was not a subject of its investigation.
